description: Avifauna y tendidos eléctricos is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geo.euskadi.eus. The growing demand for electrical energy demands the increase in the number of electrical lines and lines installed in the natural environment, which usually implies a high risk of electrocution and collision of the avifauna. At present this problem is one of the main causes of unnatural mortality more frequent in this group of vertebrates. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Avifauna and electric lines" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
